title: Ozarks Lyric Opera: Red Curtain Affair for Tosca
seo_title: Red Curtain Affair for Tosca at Gillioz Theatre
description: The Red Curtain Affair is a pre-show and intermission hospitality event for Ozarks Lyric Opera's production of Tosca, held in The Gallery on the second floor of the Gillioz Theatre. Guests get food, a complimentary drink, and backstage insights before the opera, plus sweet treats, free coffee and water, and an exclusive bar at intermission; the $60 ticket covers this event only, so a separate Tosca ticket is needed to enter the venue, and a portion of the ticketing fee supports the OLO Endowment Fund. It takes place Friday, March 19, 2027, at 325 Park Central, E Springfield, Missouri, with doors at 6 PM and the show at 6:30 PM.
